UPDATE: You can now own businesses!
🗽JOIN GROUP for EXTRA INCOME and COMMS: https://www.roblox.com/communities/35308172/Hierarchy-NYC-Community#!/about

Explore this realistic recreation of New York City in a time machine back to the 1980's with tons of interiors and hidden secrets to explore. Witness famous landmarks such as Times Square, World Trade Center, Hell's Kitchen and much more, re-created in Roblox. 

👮Want to join NYPD? https://www.roblox.com/communities/35289022/H-NYC-New-York-Police-Department#!/about

🏠Buy a apartment and invite friends!

🍕Many interactive jobs! Taxi, Trucker, Barista, Pizza Delivery, Waste Management.

💸Or get rich through the criminal underworld!

🚗Over 60 different classic cars!

🖥️High-end PC STRONGLY RECOMMENDED to have the best experience. Game supports VR.
